verdict.rationale: Twenty can be self-hosted headlessly via a single Docker Compose command and fully driven through REST/GraphQL/Metadata APIs, webhooks, and a CLI (create-twenty-app, app:publish, dev) enabling programmatic/automated operation outside the UI. However there is no explicit documentation of running Twenty inside a CI pipeline or headless test/automation harness. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, headless test-runner examples, and independent confirmation of running Twenty in CI environments.
